title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen AI Model
excerpt: Google introduces its new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, designed to better handle complex, multi-part questions and specific requests.
body_html:
Google has announced the rollout of its new Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, designed to deliver more helpful responses to difficult queries. According to the company, the updated model is built to better process requests that feature multiple parts, difficult typos, or highly specific details.

The system is capable of analyzing complex queries and breaking them down to address each individual component within its answers. The new model is available starting today across Google Search, the Gemini application, and all tiers of Google services.
